blurb: Guests can join public cruises such as brunch, dinner shows, and themed events or book private cruises for corporate events, weddings, and parties. Cruises range from 90 minutes to 3 hours and include narrated tours and live entertainment. The fleet includes three boats accommodating groups from 6 to 230 guests.
